core_meaning.primary_meaning: Nay corresponds to the Arabic form نَاي and is glossed in this record as “Reed flute.” The record associates the form with root ن و ي (n-w-y). The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Nay corresponds to the Arabic form نَاي (Arabic root ن و ي (n-w-y); نَاي (Nāy)). Its core sense is reed flute, nay. Nay is Arabic نَاي (Nāy) 'reed flute', from the root ن و ي (n-w-y). The source gloss 'Delight, Pleasure' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense.

persian.name: نای
persian.long_meaning: Nay (نای) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن نی، نای است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: नाय
hindi.long_meaning: Nay (नाय) अरबी भाषा से लिया गया नाम है। इसका मुख्य अर्थ नाय, बाँसुरी है। यह नाम मुस्लिम समाजों में रखा जाता है और इसका प्रयोग संदर्भ के अनुसार बदलता है।

arabic.name: نَاي
